images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A colony-management sim seen as a front-on cross-section of a natural honeycomb filling the left two-thirds of the screen: hundreds of hexagonal wax cells, glossy translucent amber honey cells, cream wax-capped honey at the top, tan capped brood and curled white larvae in the center, a ring of orange, yellow and olive pollen cells. Warm sunbeams slant in from the upper left with floating dust motes. In the middle a scout bee performs a figure-eight waggle dance inside a softly darkened reading circle, ringed by follower bees; a dotted figure-eight trail, a golden arrow along the waggle run and a dashed vertical reference line marked with a sun icon, with a '40°' angle arc. Small labels: '흔들기 1.6초 ≈ 1.4 km'. Right side: a dark honey-brown UI panel with a circular dial, waggle-duration bar chart and a painted top-down meadow map showing the hive, sun direction and a golden ray pointing to an acacia grove. Top HUD: '벌집 도시계획', '여왕 수명 238일'. Bottom-left cell palette chips '육아방', '저장방'. Rich painterly semi-realistic style, golden amber palette, soft glow, fine grain.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same honeycomb cross-section at dusk: light turns rose and deep orange, shadows plum-brown, most cells now white wax-capped honey. Three scout bees dance competing figure-eight dances at different angles across the comb, each color-coded — gold, pale blue and coral — with glowing dotted trails and labelled pills '가 고목 구멍 · 41', '나 바위틈 · 17', '다 헛간 처마 · 9'. A large dense cluster of hundreds of bees gathers at the lower left, ready to swarm; on the right the larger old queen sits inside a ring of attendant bees with a dashed circle. Three peanut-shaped royal queen cells hang from the bottom edge of the comb. Centered banner text '분봉 — 새 집을 춤추는 정찰벌들'. Right panel: vote bars with a quorum tick line and a dusky map showing three candidate nest sites radiating from the hive, the setting sun at the west edge. HUD: '벌집 도시계획', red '여왕 수명 3일', button '분봉 출발'. Painterly, warm dusk grading, glow, grain, tense and bittersweet. Number constraints: the vote panel shows scout counts, not percentages — "41마리", "17마리", "9마리" — with a quorum tick line labelled "정족수 30마리" that only 가 has crossed; no percent signs in the vote panel.
